item.title: ‘Five Nights At Freddy’s 2’ Hits With Record $63 Million Post Thanksgiving Box Office Weekend
item.description: There are several weekends on the box office calendar that studios and distributors know will be tough sells. Traditionally, that means the 3-day frame following the Thanksgiving holiday, when many Americans are, in theory, spending their hours hunting for holiday gifts to get in the mail. Times may be changing. Especially after “Five Nights at Freddy’s 2” earned a fantastic $63 million over the frame domestically and $109 million worldwide.
